correctness.rationale: For each injective labeled k-tuple of distinct quotient points, a homogeneous finite separation-relation cover with fibers of size d gives an un-oriented cyclic arrangement of dk preimage points, equivalently a k-colored fixed-content bracelet. Under Simon's quotient/homogeneity hypothesis the named fiber arrangement is exactly the induced tuple-orbit invariant. Burnside: rotations with cycle length ell|d contribute phi(ell)(dk/ell)!/[(d/ell)!]^k; reflection fixed positions force even d paired colors or (odd d, k=1 or 2), yielding the displayed R cases; divide by 2dk. Independently enumerated canonical bracelets for (d,k)=(1,5),(1,6),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3),(4,2),(5,1), matching formula. The identity term has log ~d k log k while other terms lower order for fixed d; Stirling equality-partition decomposition yields all-tuple transform. All d,k follow Burnside, not finite replay.
